apps.subtitle: Jellyfin player with AI recommendations.
apps.localizedDescription:
A Jellyfin player for iPhone with a Liquid Glass look.

• Plays every file directly on the phone (mpv engine), with server conversion only as a last resort
• Picture in Picture, AirPlay, HDR, two subtitles at once, skip intro/credits, trickplay
• For You: AI picks from your own library, explained by Apple Intelligence
• My List and Not for me are saved on your Jellyfin server, not the phone
• Server dashboard for administrators

Requires your own Jellyfin server. iOS 26 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: Use the repo's canonical name in AltStore URLs

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: JellyReco connects to your Jellyfin server on your home network.
